name: Rocks Enveloped in Kuuvahki...
desc:
An ordinary stone. Since it was enveloped by pure kuuvahki energy, it can be absorbed and thrown.
Though it may seem capable only of shattering fragile structures, with careful consideration, it may have some ingenious applications yet...
